title: Unverified pricing requires an explicit per-item spend cap
goal: Create a resource plan with a hard budget of 30 credits. Add one web search item for the query 'notion pricing page' using the web_search.tavily capability. Its pricing is unverified, so the CLI will refuse to quote it unless you set a per-item spend cap with --max-credits; use a cap of at most 15 credits. Finish with a quote whose status is ready.
